iran: Suspends MoU commitments · 2 US killed, 1 missing after Jordan attack
tldr: The Pentagon confirmed two US personnel killed and one missing after the Jordan attack — first US fatalities of this period. Iran announced it was suspending its own commitments under the June memorandum, and the Bonji desalination plant was destroyed amid strikes cutting bridges near Bandar Abbas.
dossier: A US service member died in northern Iraq during disposal of an unexploded Iranian drone ordnance — dated July 18 by GlobalSecurity, Sunday July 19 (Sgt. Swinton, Erbil) by other accounts; treated here as the July 18–19 window.
